problem.statement: Kaydence's ten screen boards and its built P1 screens carry drift across theme, layout, and text; selecting screens from an inconsistent set guarantees repeated rework and reads as unfinished, undermining the cohesion a privacy-first dictation utility needs to feel indispensable.
successCriteria: Every built screen realizes ONE locked design language from a single token source, with no hardcoded visual values.
A blind critic cannot identify a screen's OS lane except by the single allowed accent color.
The operator rates the locked visualization at least 9 out of 10, replacing the ad-hoc P1-G4 screen-selection path.

domain.name: Desktop Productivity — on-device dictation UX / HCI

definitionOfDone.claim: Every built screen resolves 100% of color, type, spacing, radius, and motion from one tokens source of truth.
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: A grep of the screen source finds any hardcoded hex, ad-hoc px, or inline color outside the token layer.

definitionOfDone.claim: Screens are OS-blind except for the single free-tier accent (macOS aqua / Windows cobalt / Linux emerald).
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: A blind critic correctly names a screen's OS lane from any cue other than the accent (layout, type, spacing, component style).

definitionOfDone.claim: Each built screen matches its locked board composition and hierarchy.
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: A per-family blind critic marks a composition or hierarchy deviation from the locked board.

definitionOfDone.claim: Default, light, and dark themes render intentionally on every screen and pass AA contrast.
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: Any theme is missing on any screen, or any screen fails AA contrast in any theme.

definitionOfDone.claim: The locked visual direction reads as cohesive and premium as the confirmed competitor peg set on a blind side-by-side.
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: A blind panel ranks Kaydence below the peg set on cohesion or finish.

definitionOfDone.claim: The operator accepts the locked visualization as the design language for all screens (hybridized P1-G4).
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: Operator rates the locked visualization below 9/10 (human gate — only the operator closes it).

confidence.biggestRisk: The D4 rebuild must port the locked visual system into real production TSX/CSS without regressing existing React behavior (state, IPC, hooks) — a reskin that silently breaks functionality would be worse than the drift it replaces.
confidence.nextAction: Run D4: rebuild families 01/03/07/10 from the locked tokens/nav/lexicon in an isolated worktree, verified against R1-R8 plus a real typecheck/build gate, before the fresh Board-10 capture (D5).

rejectedAlternatives.idea: Continue the current P1-G4 board-selection path
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Selecting from an inconsistent set locks the drift in; operator wants to improve beyond it. Kept as fallback, not chosen.

rejectedAlternatives.idea: Run a gauntlet-lite wow prototype and skip the token/arch discipline
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Produces a wowed prototype that can't pass a real gate; the design lock must be a proof (archipelago), since it graduates the P1-G4 gate.
